name: SCICOM
recent: Scicom 在 2026 年 11 月 27 日公布季度业绩，营收突破 1 亿令吉并创下季度盈利新高，公司也宣布派发每股 3.0 仙的首次中期股息，并将于 12 月 7 日召开第 24 届常年股东大会。
notable: 宣布每股 3.0 仙的首次中期单层股息，除权日为 2026 年 12 月 11 日。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收超过 1 亿令吉并录得创纪录季度盈利。
risks: 大股东兼董事 Dato' Sri Leo Suresh Ariyanayakam 在 10 月 13 日至 15 日期间有多笔股权变动申报。
Krishnan A/L C K Menon 在 9 月 14 日申报董事及大股东权益变动。
Sreekumar A/L P Narayana Pillai 在 9 月 14 日发出不再是大股东的停止通知。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 7897 万令吉，环比下降 0.3%，但同比增长 70.0%；净利为 1261 万令吉，环比增长 13.8%，同比增长 201.6%；净利率为 16.0%，高于上一季度的 14.0%。

recent_en: Scicom announced quarterly results on 27 November 2026, with revenue surpassing RM100 million and record quarterly earnings, and proposed a 1-for-10 bonus issue.
notable_en: Proposed a bonus issue of up to 35,545,356 new shares on a 1-for-10 basis.
Declared a first interim single-tier dividend of 3.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 11 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue exceeding RM100 million and record quarterly earnings.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder and director Dato' Sri Leo Suresh Ariyanayakam filed multiple changes in interest between 13 and 15 October.
Krishnan A/L C K Menon filed changes in director and substantial shareholder interest on 14 September.
Sreekumar A/L P Narayana Pillai issued a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 14 September.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM78.97 million, down 0.3% QoQ but up 70.0% YoY; net income was RM12.61 million, up 13.8% QoQ and 201.6% YoY; net margin was 16.0% versus 14.0% in the previous quarter.
